components.css: .ds-stack{width:360px;background:var(--panel,#262626);font:13px system-ui,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--text,#E6E6E6)}.ds-node{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline,#3A3A3A)}.ds-node-heading{display:flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center}.ds-disclosure{min-width:0;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-weight:600;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-disclosure:hover{background:var(--raised,#2E2E2E)}.ds-disclosure:active{background:var(--hairline,#3A3A3A)}.ds-disclosure:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#FF3D7F);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-chevron{flex-shrink:0;fill:none;stroke:var(--secondary,#A3A3A3);stroke-width:1.5;transition:transform 140ms ease-out}.ds-disclosure[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-chevron{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-switch{width:52px;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch input{appearance:none;width:36px;height:20px;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--secondary,#A3A3A3);border-radius:10px;background:var(--ground,#1A1A1A);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out}.ds-switch input::before{content:"";display:block;width:14px;height:14px;margin:2px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--secondary,#A3A3A3);transition:transform 140ms ease-out}.ds-switch input:checked{border-color:var(--accent,#FF3D7F);background:var(--accent,#FF3D7F)}.ds-switch input:checked::before{background:var(--ground,#1A1A1A);transform:translateX(16px)}.ds-switch:hover input{border-color:var(--text,#E6E6E6)}.ds-switch:has(:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--accent,#FF3D7F);outline-offset:-2px}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-chevron,.ds-switch input,.ds-switch input::before{transition-duration:0ms}}

components.name: Range Row

components.css: .ds-stack{width:360px;background:var(--panel,#262626);font:13px system-ui,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--text,#E6E6E6);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-range-row{min-height:44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px minmax(0,1fr) 48px;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;font-size:12px}.ds-range-label{line-height:1.25}.ds-range-value{width:48px;text-align:right;color:var(--secondary,#A3A3A3)}.ds-range{appearance:none;width:100%;min-width:0;height:44px;margin:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px}.ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--secondary,#A3A3A3) 0 var(--fill),var(--hairline,#3A3A3A) var(--fill) 100%)}.ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;width:16px;height:16px;margin-top:-5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#FF3D7F)}.ds-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb{outline:2px solid var(--text,#E6E6E6);outline-offset:2px}.ds-range::-moz-range-track{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--hairline,#3A3A3A)}.ds-range::-moz-range-progress{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--secondary,#A3A3A3)}.ds-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#FF3D7F)}.ds-range:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#FF3D7F);outline-offset:-2px}

narrative.overview:
noisy's shell is the category standard executed straight: layers on the left, the picture in the center, the node stack on the right, the modes along the bottom. It sits beside Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve and borrows their discipline, not their chrome: three mid-dark grays, one-pixel hairlines, the system font at 13 px, and one hot-pink accent that marks exactly the things a hand is about to touch. The early-2000s point-and-shoot identity lives in the rendered picture and the status voice; the shell never performs it.

Density is editing-suite density. Every bar is 44 px, every control row is 44 px, every button is a 44 px target, and the stage is the largest thing on the page, sitting on the ground with 16 px margins. Nothing on the shell asks for attention, so the fried photograph does.
keyCharacteristics: Four grays stepped 8 units apart (ground, panel, raised, hairline); never pure black.
One accent for the primary action, focus, selection, slider thumbs, switches on, and text selection; nowhere else.
System font stack, three sizes (13, 12, 11), tabular numerals on every value.
Flat: no shadows, no glass, no decorative gradients, 4 px radius on controls, 0 on rows.
One motion duration, 140 ms ease-out, on switches and disclosure chevrons only.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks what a hand is about to touch or has just chosen: the primary action, focus, selection, a thumb, a switch that is on. It never fills a panel, a heading, a divider, or a label.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest surface is `ground`. Pure black appears nowhere in the shell; the icon's near-black is an open product question, not a shell token.

rules.name: The Gray Fill Rule
rules.body: A range track fills with `secondary`, not the accent; the accent is the thumb alone.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: 13, 12, 11. A new element takes one of these; it does not introduce a fourth.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number on the page sits in tabular figures so values do not jitter while a slider moves.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A state change moves a surface exactly one step up the gray ramp. Nothing floats.

dos: **Do** make every new bar, heading, node header, range row, and button 44 px; a layer row is 64 px and the Fry dial row is 48 px.

**Do** add a node as a `Node` with a title-case name, a hairline below, the chevron disclosure, and range rows at 12 px with a 48 px value field; put an enable switch in the header only if the node can be turned off.
**Do** add a mode as a toggle button in the mode rail with `aria-pressed`, 12 px label, sharing state with the node's enable switch so both flip together.
**Do** take colors from the ten `:root` tokens and sizes from 13, 12, 11; take spacing from 4, 8, 12, 16.
**Do** mark hover with one tonal step up and press with two; mark selection with a 1 px inset `accent` outline on a `raised` fill.
**Do** keep the accent on the Download button, focus, selection, thumbs, and switches that are on, and nowhere else.
**Do** keep the status line as the page's only voice, at 13 px in `text`, readable over the fried image.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by zeroing the 140 ms transition, as the switches and chevrons already do.
donts: **Don't** use pure black, a shadow, a blur, glass, or a decorative gradient; the range track's hard two-stop fill is the only gradient allowed.
**Don't** introduce an icon font, a glyph set, or a second inline icon style; the 16 px 1.5-stroke chevron is the only icon.
**Don't** add a display face, a wordmark, a kicker, an eyebrow, or an uppercase heading outside the two sidebar panel headings.
**Don't** set text below 11 px or add a fourth type size.
**Don't** render an accent-colored focus ring on an accent-colored surface; use the `text` or `ground` ring the primary action and swatches use.
**Don't** animate anything but switch fill, switch knob, and disclosure chevron, and never at a duration other than 140 ms ease-out.
**Don't** give a row a radius; 4 px belongs to controls, 0 to rows that span their column.
**Don't** fill a range track with the accent; the fill is `secondary`, the thumb is the accent.
narrative.notCanonized: The contract names a 40 px bottom strip, a Publish action, and a Before/After toggle; the build ships a 44 px bottom bar and neither control. The range track's two-stop linear-gradient fill stands despite the contract's 'no gradient' because the build uses it natively as a hard fill. The 1100 px tier is a build extension the contract does not name. '3 models local' is hard-coded where the contract says it follows the lock.
